cause: Dashboard card rows had inconsistent widths and excess calendar space.
solution: Normalized grid/card sizing and tightened calendar section spacing.

cause: Desktop sidebar displayed an unwanted native scrollbar.
solution: Adjusted sidebar navigation overflow handling and hidden scrollbar styling.

cause: Server Action writes were not visibly reflected after submit.
solution: Redirected create actions to the created detail pages and status actions back to lists.

cause: Operations had create/status flows but no complete edit path for correcting data after creation.
solution: Added protected edit pages, Server Actions, PATCH Route Handlers and Playwright coverage for reservation, task and incident edits.

cause: E2E looked for readonly input value as text content.
solution: Changed the assertion to validate the input value with toHaveValue and kept the Settings profile form accessible.

cause: Calendar matrix selected most recent properties including archived E2E records, hiding active demo assets.
solution: Filtered archived properties from calendar source before building the availability matrix.
